367			return n, nil
368		}
369		// The last complete line is the segment right before lastNL.
370		completed := p.partial[:lastNL]
371		p.partial = p.partial[lastNL+1:]
372		prevNL := bytes.LastIndexByte(completed, '\n')
373		var last []byte
374		if prevNL < 0 {
375			last = completed
376		} else {
377			last = completed[prevNL+1:]
378		}
379		if len(last) == 0 {
380			return n, nil
381		}
382		now := time.Now()
383		if now.Sub(p.lastSentAt) < previewRateWindow {
384			return n, nil
385		}
386		p.lastSentAt = now
387		// Copy into a new buffer because p.partial's backing array is reused.
388		line := string(bytes.TrimRight(last, "\r"))
389		p.send(agentPreviewMsg{Name: p.agentName, Line: line})
390		return n, nil
391	}
392	
393	// dumpMultiAgentResults prints per-agent headers + FinalOutput, then a
394	// summary line, then transcript paths for successful agents.
395	func dumpMultiAgentResults(out io.Writer, tasks []MultiAgentTask, results []AgentRunResult, cancelled bool) {
396		for i, r := range results {
397			fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n─────── %s review ───────\n", tasks[i].Name)
398			switch r.Status {
399			case AgentRunFailed:
400				fmt.Fprintf(out, "(failed — exit %d)\n", r.ExitCode)
401				if r.Err != nil {
402					fmt.Fprintf(out, "%v\n\n", r.Err)
403				}
404			case AgentRunCancelled:
405				fmt.Fprintln(out, "(cancelled)")
406				fmt.Fprintln(out)
407				// Skip the FinalOutput dump for cancelled agents. The buffered
408				// partial stdout is rarely useful (often 100+ lines of noise
409				// from agents like codex that stream verbosely) and the user
410				// explicitly asked to stop — dumping would be adversarial.
411				continue
412			case AgentRunQueued, AgentRunRunning, AgentRunDone:
413				// Done: no header; buffered output follows.
414				// Queued/Running would indicate a logic bug; fall through.
415			}
416			if _, err := out.Write(r.FinalOutput); err != nil {
417				// Writer failed mid-dump; further writes will also fail, so stop.
418				return
419			}
420		}
421	
422		var nSucc, nFail, nCancel int
423		for _, r := range results {
424			switch r.Status {
425			case AgentRunDone:
426				nSucc++
427			case AgentRunFailed:
428				nFail++
429			case AgentRunCancelled:
430				nCancel++
431			case AgentRunQueued, AgentRunRunning:
432				// Should not occur after Wait; ignore for summary stats.
433			}
434		}
435		fmt.Fprintln(out)
436		fmt.Fprintf(out, "%d agents done in %s (%d succeeded, %d failed, %d cancelled)\n",
437			len(results), computeTotalDuration(results), nSucc, nFail, nCancel)
438		if !cancelled && nSucc > 0 {
439			fmt.Fprintln(out, "  Run `git commit` to attach the review to the next checkpoint.")
440		}
441	
442		anyPath := false
443		for _, r := range results {
444			if r.TranscriptPath == "" {
445				continue
446			}
447			if !anyPath {
448				fmt.Fprintln(out, "\n  Full transcripts (including tool calls + reasoning):")
449				anyPath = true
450			}
451			fmt.Fprintf(out, "    %-12s → %s\n", r.Name, r.TranscriptPath)
452		}
453	}
454	
455	// computeTotalDuration returns the maximum Duration across results — the
456	// wall-clock span of the whole parallel run, not the sum of per-agent
457	// runtimes.
458	func computeTotalDuration(results []AgentRunResult) time.Duration {
459		var longest time.Duration
460		for _, r := range results {
461			if r.Duration > longest {
462				longest = r.Duration
463			}
464		}
465		return longest
466	}
467	
468	// forceKillAll sends SIGKILL to every live subprocess. Null cmds (agents
469	// whose LaunchHeadlessCmd call had not returned yet when cancellation
470	// arrived) are skipped.
471	func forceKillAll(cmds []*exec.Cmd) {
472		for _, cmd := range cmds {
473			if cmd == nil || cmd.Process == nil {
474				continue
475			}
476			_ = cmd.Process.Kill() //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup after cancel
477		}
478	}
479	
480	// resolveLatestTranscript returns the newest .jsonl (or .json) file under
481	// baseDir, searched recursively. Returns "" if baseDir is empty, unreadable,
482	// or contains no transcript files. Uses a best-effort newest-file
483	// heuristic; a future refinement could switch to a session-ID-specific
484	// resolver.
485	func resolveLatestTranscript(baseDir string) string {
486		if baseDir == "" {
487			return ""
488		}
489		var latestPath string
490		var latestMod time.Time
491		walkErr := walkTranscriptFiles(baseDir, func(path string, info os.FileInfo) {
492			if info.ModTime().After(latestMod) {
493				latestMod = info.ModTime()
494				latestPath = path
495			}
496		})
497		if walkErr != nil {
498			return ""
499		}
500		return latestPath
501	}
502	
503	// walkTranscriptFiles walks baseDir recursively, invoking visit for every
504	// file whose extension is .jsonl or .json. Non-existent or unreadable
505	// directories return an error; individual read errors inside are silently
506	// skipped (best-effort resolution).
507	func walkTranscriptFiles(baseDir string, visit func(path string, info os.FileInfo)) error {
508		entries, err := os.ReadDir(baseDir)
509		if err != nil {
510			return fmt.Errorf("read transcript dir: %w", err)
511		}
512		for _, e := range entries {
513			full := baseDir + string(os.PathSeparator) + e.Name()
514			if e.IsDir() {
515				_ = walkTranscriptFiles(full, visit) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort
516				continue
517			}
518			name := e.Name()
519			if !hasTranscriptExt(name) {
520				continue
521			}
522			info, infoErr := e.Info()
523			if infoErr != nil {
524				continue
525			}
526			visit(full, info)
527		}
528		return nil
529	}
530	
531	func hasTranscriptExt(name string) bool {
532		for _, ext := range []string{".jsonl", ".json"} {
533			if len(name) >= len(ext) && name[len(name)-len(ext):] == ext {
534				return true
535			}
536		}
537		return false
538	}
539	
540	// atomicBool is a tiny mutex-guarded boolean used to flip the "cancelled"
541	// flag from the signal goroutine and read it from the completion path.
542	// Using sync/atomic.Bool would work too, but a mutex keeps the call sites
543	// explicit and matches the plan's spec.
544	type atomicBool struct {
545		mu sync.Mutex
546		v  bool
547	}
548	
549	func (b *atomicBool) store(v bool) {
550		b.mu.Lock()
551		defer b.mu.Unlock()
552		b.v = v
553	}
554	
555	func (b *atomicBool) load() bool {
556		b.mu.Lock()
557		defer b.mu.Unlock()
558		return b.v
559	}

1	package cli
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"regexp"
6		"strings"
7		"time"
8	
9		"github.com/charmbracelet/bubbles/spinner"
10		tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
11		"github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss"
12	)
13	
14	// reviewTUIModel renders the multi-agent status table: one row per agent
15	// with spinner, status, duration, token usage, and a faint preview line.
16	// The model is a pure tea.Model — orchestration and subprocess wiring live
17	// in review_multi.go, which posts agentStateMsg / agentPreviewMsg as the
18	// underlying agents progress.
19	//
20	// On every row reaching a terminal state (Done, Failed, or Cancelled),
21	// Update returns tea.Quit so the program exits and the caller can dump
22	// full final responses.
23	type reviewTUIModel struct {
24		tasks      []MultiAgentTask
25		rows       []rowState
26		spinner    spinner.Model
27		startTime  time.Time
28		termWidth  int
29		allDone    bool
30		cancelling bool
31		// onCancel, if non-nil, is invoked the first time the user triggers
32		// cancellation from within the TUI (Ctrl+C or 'q'). The orchestrator
33		// wires this to its runCtx cancel function so raw-mode-captured Ctrl+C
34		// still tears down subprocesses — bubbletea intercepts byte 0x03 before
35		// it can reach the orchestrator's signal.Notify handler.
36		onCancel func()
37	}
38	
39	// rowState is the per-agent render state. Mutated only from Update via the
40	// incoming tea messages — never shared with orchestrator goroutines.
41	type rowState struct {
42		name     string
43		status   AgentRunStatus
44		duration time.Duration
45		tokens   int
46		preview  string
47		exitCode int
48	}
49	
50	// agentStateMsg is posted by the orchestrator when an agent transitions
51	// between lifecycle states (queued → running → done/failed/cancelled) or
52	// when token usage becomes known after exit.
53	type agentStateMsg struct {
54		Name     string
55		Status   AgentRunStatus
56		Duration time.Duration
57		ExitCode int
58		Tokens   int
59	}
60	
61	// agentPreviewMsg is posted (rate-limited by the teeWriter) when an agent
62	// emits a new non-empty stdout line. The model ANSI-strips and width-
63	// truncates before rendering.
64	type agentPreviewMsg struct {
65		Name string
66		Line string
67	}
68	
69	// cancelMsg toggles the "cancelling" banner. The orchestrator posts it
70	// when it starts to SIGTERM subprocesses after a user Ctrl+C.
71	type cancelMsg struct{}
72	
73	// tickMsg fires every 100ms; drives per-row duration counters for rows
74	// still in AgentRunRunning. Avoids the need for the orchestrator to push
75	// periodic state updates just for the timer.
76	type tickMsg time.Time
77	
78	// ansiRe matches standard CSI escape sequences. Agent stdout is rarely
79	// colored but users can pipe through `--color=always` wrappers — strip
80	// them so the TUI's own styling remains consistent.
81	var ansiRe = regexp.MustCompile(`\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]`)
82	
83	// stripANSI removes CSI color codes from s so preview lines don't inject
84	// escape sequences into the TUI render.
85	func stripANSI(s string) string {
86		return ansiRe.ReplaceAllString(s, "")
87	}
88	
89	// newReviewTUIModel constructs a model pre-populated with one queued row
90	// per task. Callers pass the same task list they'll hand the orchestrator,
91	// so row names line up with the agentStateMsg.Name values posted later.
92	// onCancel, if non-nil, is invoked the first time the user presses Ctrl+C
93	// or 'q' inside the TUI so the orchestrator can tear down subprocesses.
94	// Pass nil when cancellation wiring isn't needed (e.g. in unit tests).
95	func newReviewTUIModel(tasks []MultiAgentTask, onCancel func()) reviewTUIModel {
96		rows := make([]rowState, len(tasks))
97		for i, t := range tasks {
98			rows[i] = rowState{name: t.Name, status: AgentRunQueued}
99		}
100		sp := spinner.New()
101		sp.Spinner = spinner.Dot
102		return reviewTUIModel{
103			tasks:     tasks,
104			rows:      rows,
105			spinner:   sp,
106			startTime: time.Now(),
107			termWidth: 80,
108			onCancel:  onCancel,
109		}
110	}
111	
112	// Init kicks off the spinner animation and the duration-tick timer.
113	func (m reviewTUIModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
114		return tea.Batch(m.spinner.Tick, tickEvery())
115	}
116	
117	// tickEvery schedules the next tickMsg 100ms in the future. Update
118	// re-schedules itself in response to each tickMsg it receives.
119	func tickEvery() tea.Cmd {
120		return tea.Tick(100*time.Millisecond, func(t time.Time) tea.Msg { return tickMsg(t) })
121	}
122	
123	// Update handles all model messages. Mutates m by value (tea.Model
124	// contract) and returns the updated model plus any follow-up commands.
125	//
126	//nolint:ireturn // tea.Model interface contract — bubbletea requires returning the interface.
127	func (m reviewTUIModel) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
128		switch msg := msg.(type) {
129		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
130			m.termWidth = msg.Width
131		case tea.KeyMsg:
132			// Ctrl+C (or 'q') flips the cancelling banner immediately for
133			// user feedback and fires the orchestrator-supplied cancel hook.
134			// The hook must be called from here — bubbletea puts the terminal
135			// in raw mode, so byte 0x03 is captured as a KeyMsg and never
136			// reaches the OS as SIGINT. The orchestrator's signal.Notify
137			// handler therefore never fires for in-TUI Ctrl+C; we have to
138			// cancel runCtx directly via m.onCancel. Guarded on !m.cancelling
139			// so repeat key presses don't re-fire the hook.
140			if msg.Type == tea.KeyCtrlC || msg.String() == "q" {
141				if !m.cancelling && m.onCancel != nil {
142					m.onCancel()
143				}
144				m.cancelling = true
145			}
146		case agentStateMsg:
147			for i, r := range m.rows {
148				if r.name == msg.Name {
149					m.rows[i].status = msg.Status
150					if msg.Duration > 0 {
151						m.rows[i].duration = msg.Duration
152					}
153					m.rows[i].exitCode = msg.ExitCode
154					m.rows[i].tokens = msg.Tokens
155					break
156				}
157			}
158			if m.allRowsTerminal() {
159				m.allDone = true
160				return m, tea.Quit
161			}
162		case agentPreviewMsg:
163			for i, r := range m.rows {
164				if r.name == msg.Name {
165					m.rows[i].preview = truncatePreview(msg.Line, m.termWidth)
166					break
167				}
168			}
169		case cancelMsg:
170			m.cancelling = true
171		case tickMsg:
172			now := time.Now()
173			for i, r := range m.rows {
174				if r.status == AgentRunRunning {
175					m.rows[i].duration = now.Sub(m.startTime)
176				}
177			}
178			return m, tickEvery()
179		case spinner.TickMsg:
180			var cmd tea.Cmd
181			m.spinner, cmd = m.spinner.Update(msg)
182			return m, cmd
183		}
184		return m, nil
185	}
186	
187	// truncatePreview ANSI-strips line then trims to fit terminal width minus
188	// the row-prefix padding. A 20-char floor guards against absurdly narrow
189	// terminals where trimming would leave nothing meaningful.
190	func truncatePreview(line string, termWidth int) string {
191		stripped := stripANSI(line)
192		maxLine := termWidth - 18
193		if maxLine < 20 {
194			maxLine = 20
195		}
196		if len(stripped) > maxLine {
197			stripped = stripped[:maxLine-1] + "…"
198		}
199		return stripped
200	}
201	
202	// View renders the full status table. Called on every Update cycle.
203	func (m reviewTUIModel) View() string {
204		var sb strings.Builder
205		sb.WriteString("Running ")
206		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "%d agents — Ctrl+C to cancel all\n\n", len(m.rows))
207		if m.cancelling {
208			sb.WriteString("Cancelling — sending SIGTERM to subprocesses…\n\n")
209		}
210		sb.WriteString(strings.Repeat("─", 44) + "\n")
211		for _, r := range m.rows {
212			icon := rowIcon(r.status, m.spinner.View())
213			status := statusString(r.status)
214			dur := formatDuration(r.duration)
215			tok := "—"
216			if r.tokens > 0 {
217				tok = fmt.Sprintf("%dk", r.tokens/1000)
218			}
219			line := fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %-15s %-10s %7s  %5s\n",
220				icon, r.name, status, dur, tok)
221			sb.WriteString(line)
222			if r.preview != "" {
223				sb.WriteString("       ")
224				sb.WriteString(lipgloss.NewStyle().Faint(true).Render("… " + r.preview))
225				sb.WriteString("\n")
226			}
227		}
228		sb.WriteString(strings.Repeat("─", 44) + "\n")
229		completed := 0
230		for _, r := range m.rows {
231			if isTerminalStatus(r.status) {
232				completed++
233			}
234		}
235		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "%d of %d complete\n", completed, len(m.rows))
236		return sb.String()
237	}
238	
239	// allRowsTerminal returns true iff every row has a final status. Used to
240	// decide when to emit tea.Quit.
241	func (m reviewTUIModel) allRowsTerminal() bool {
242		for _, r := range m.rows {
243			if !isTerminalStatus(r.status) {
244				return false
245			}
246		}
247		return true
248	}
249	
250	// isTerminalStatus reports whether an agent run has reached an endpoint
251	// (Done, Failed, or Cancelled) and will not transition further.
252	func isTerminalStatus(s AgentRunStatus) bool {
253		switch s {
254		case AgentRunDone, AgentRunFailed, AgentRunCancelled:
255			return true
256		case AgentRunQueued, AgentRunRunning:
257			return false
258		}
259		return false
260	}
261	
262	// rowIcon maps a status to its leading glyph; running rows render the
263	// live spinner character.
264	func rowIcon(status AgentRunStatus, spin string) string {
265		switch status {
266		case AgentRunDone:
267			return "✓"
268		case AgentRunFailed:
269			return "✗"
270		case AgentRunCancelled:
271			return "⊘"
272		case AgentRunRunning:
273			return spin
274		case AgentRunQueued:
275			return " "
276		}
277		return " "
278	}
279	
280	// statusString maps a status to a short lowercase label shown in the row.
281	func statusString(status AgentRunStatus) string {
282		switch status {
283		case AgentRunDone:
284			return "done"
285		case AgentRunFailed:
286			return "failed"
287		case AgentRunCancelled:
288			return "cancelled"
289		case AgentRunRunning:
290			return "running"
291		case AgentRunQueued:
292			return "queued"
293		}
294		return "queued"
295	}
296	
297	// formatDuration renders a duration as "Ns" under a minute, "Nm Ms"
298	// beyond. Zero duration renders as an em-dash so queued rows show blank-
299	// ish rather than "0s".
300	func formatDuration(d time.Duration) string {
301		if d == 0 {
302			return "—"
303		}
304		s := int(d.Seconds())
305		if s < 60 {
306			return fmt.Sprintf("%ds", s)
307		}
308		return fmt.Sprintf("%dm %ds", s/60, s%60)
309	}

13	// TestTUIModel_InitialViewAllQueued pins that newReviewTUIModel renders all
14	// configured agents as "queued" before any state messages arrive.
15	func TestTUIModel_InitialViewAllQueued(t *testing.T) {
16		t.Parallel()
17		m := newReviewTUIModel([]MultiAgentTask{
18			{Name: "a"}, {Name: "b"}, {Name: "c"},
19		}, nil)
20		tm := teatest.NewTestModel(t, m, teatest.WithInitialTermSize(120, 20))

22		// Force quit quickly so FinalOutput terminates. The model exits on
23		// its own only when all rows are terminal; here we haven't sent any
24		// state msgs, so we need an explicit Quit.
25		if err := tm.Quit(); err != nil {
26			t.Fatalf("Quit: %v", err)
27		}

29		if readErr != nil {

34			t.Errorf("initial view should contain 'queued'; got:\n%s", view)
35		}

37			t.Errorf("initial view should list all 3 agents; got:\n%s", view)

91	// TestTUIModel_KeyCtrlCCallsOnCancel pins the fix for the raw-mode Ctrl+C
92	// bug: when bubbletea delivers KeyCtrlC to the model, the onCancel hook
93	// must fire so the orchestrator can tear down subprocesses. Without this,
94	// Ctrl+C only flips the banner and the subprocesses keep running because
95	// the terminal swallowed the 0x03 byte before it could become a SIGINT.
96	func TestTUIModel_KeyCtrlCCallsOnCancel(t *testing.T) {
97		t.Parallel()
98		called := false
99		m := newReviewTUIModel([]MultiAgentTask{{Name: "a"}}, func() { called = true })
100		tm := teatest.NewTestModel(t, m, teatest.WithInitialTermSize(120, 20))
101		tm.Send(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyCtrlC})
102		// Send a terminal state so the model quits and the test finishes.
103		tm.Send(agentStateMsg{Name: "a", Status: AgentRunCancelled, Duration: time.Second})
104		tm.WaitFinished(t, teatest.WithFinalTimeout(500*time.Millisecond))

content.text:
`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
Two design decisions in `detailView()` worth noting: (1) `detailScroll` is clamped against `len(lines) - viewport` inside the render, not the Update branch. This means the user can press ↑ indefinitely and the cap happens at paint time — simpler than tracking buffer length on every keystroke, and robust against the buffer growing underneath the TUI. (2) Scroll offset 0 pins the tail (most recent), not the head. That matches what users expect from `tail -f`-style drill-ins and avoids a jarring "scroll-to-bottom" every time fresh output arrives while scrolled near the end.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
